I am a PhD Candidate at the Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University. My research interests are household finance, real estate finance, and public finance.

Before starting my PhD, I was a Research Assistant in the Finance Group at the [Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago](https://www.chicagofed.org/).
